title: messaging: a Slack link proposal that can no longer be confirmed still blocks the next holder of that email — drop or ignore stale proposals
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2

Filing gate: ② review follow-up on PR #35789 (#34730 step 2), routed to an area card. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Rule.** After #35789, a proposal is confirmable only while its person's email is still verified and is still the email it was made for. A proposed `sys_channel_user_link` row that can no longer be confirmed still counts as taking its Slack user (`taken` check in `slack-links.ts` `propose`), so the next person whose verified email matches that Slack user gets no proposal. Rule: a proposed row stops counting once its person's email changes or is no longer verified. Either drop proposals when `sys_user.email` / `email_verified` changes (an engine hook, as the user-delete/ban riders do), or ignore a proposed row whose stored email hash no longer matches its person's current verified email.

Pins: person A's proposal, A changes email, person B with the matching verified email then gets a proposal; a confirmed link still blocks as before.

Blocked-by: #35789.
Suggested-grade: p3 · edge case after an email change; no data loss.
Dedupe: `slack proposal stale`, `sys_channel_user_link proposed` (searched before filing).
